differences_first.finding: The plume now begins along the curled distal tail, retains the dark outer crest and continuous white inner band, and removes the pale base loops. It still has fewer, longer needle-like dark locks and a narrower white band than the dense short overlapping locks in the sheet. The upper white carrier remains spear-like. This is not a sheet match.

Toe lobes separate better in front and three-quarter views, and small claws remain exposed. Gray paw tops are retained. Some grooves appear angular and drawn onto a smooth paw rather than naturally separated fur lobes.

Final 192 px sprite has visibly sharper horn edges, body fur and leg contours than pass 4. The sheet panel now contains the full tail with a safe inset. Final 512 px portrait retains clear fur detail after downsampling.
The upper eye boundary is flatter while the seated amber eyes and horizontal pupils are retained. No new visible hair obstruction of iris or nose appears.

body_preservation.scope: Supplied technical check reports exact float32 coordinates, root color, gain and strand tone for 470208 inherited body strands, excluding face, ears, paws and distal shaft. Independently read, not recomputed by this reviewer.

independent.toe_close: Inspected render_toes.png. Four distinct claw-bearing lobes, gray paw tops and exposed small claws confirmed. Angular, drawn-looking skin grooves remain a finish limitation.
independent.deformation: Inspected deformation_side.png and deformation_check.json. Bent hind leg and tail visibly carry the coat without gross detached clusters. Supplied raw aggregate passed is false because line 552 requires every plume tuft to move more than 0.01 m; base crest_01 moves only 0.00435 m. All reported root errors are 0 and maximum strand-length error is about 5.01e-7 m, below the stated 2e-5 m tolerance. Sculpt base geometry unchanged is true. These data support attachment while the aggregate movement gate fails; do not call the raw aggregate a pass.
independent.decision: Final proof package has meaningful crispness, plume continuity and toe-read improvements. Preserve residual findings in report.json. No blanket sheet-match claim and no art director approval implied.
independent.limits: Visual inspection of all eight required final renders, extra toe close and deformation side render, plus reading supplied preservation and deformation evidence. Reviewer did not run Blender or modify groom scripts. No art director approval implied.
